name: Pork Sausage with Honey-Roasted Root Veggies, Arugula & Dilly Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb sweet potatoes
3 medium beets
3 medium turnips
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Divide between two baking sheet pans.
Peel and trim beets and turnips; halve each lengthwise, then slice into ¼-inch thick wedges. Add both to the baking sheets with the sweet potato.
Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ¼-inch thick wedges. Add to the baking sheets. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until just fork-tender, about 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When the skillet is hot, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat, cover to keep warm, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
6 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: While the sausages are cooking, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the garlic. (Reserve a small handful of dill for serving.)
Juice lemons into the bowl. Add yogurt, milk, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 fl oz (⅜ cup) whole milk
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are just tender, remove baking sheets from the oven, then drizzle with honey. Toss to combine and spread back out in an even layer. Return baking sheets to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are caramelized, 6-7 minutes.
Remove baking sheets from the oven. Carefully transfer warm veggies to a large bowl. Add arugula, then gently toss until slightly wilted and salad is combined, 1-2 minutes.
To serve, divide salad and sausages between plates or bowls. Drizzle with dressing, sprinkle with reserved dill, and enjoy!
